content: Jeremías-esgaryagi-gales-sigisad
Babilonia-rey-Nabucodonosor, Joacim-machi-Conías-muchub, Josías-machi-Sedequías Judá-reyga omesisad.
Degi-inigwele, Sedequíasʼbela, degi, ega-arbamaladbela, degine, Judá-dulemarbela gwen Bab-Jehová-sogedba ibsassurmalad. Bab-Jehová e-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremíasʼba-ibmar-sogsad itossurmalad.

Degi, Rey-Sedequías, Selemías-machi-Jucal dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Sofoníasʼbo Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremíasʼse barmisad. Sofoníasʼde Maasías-machid. Jeremíasʼga weyob sogdapmalad: “Anmar-ular be, anmar-Bab-Dummad-Jehováʼse be anmarga gole.”
Deunni, Jeremías amba yoo esgaryaba mellegedgined, degisoggu nabir dulemar-imbagi garmakdiid.
Deginbali, a-ibagangine, Faraón-sordamar Egiptoʼgi ainis danimalad. Deyob Babilonia-sordamar-Jerusalén-ebilis-bukwad wisguargu, gannar e-yarse duurmakdemalad.
Bab-Jehová-gayaburba Jeremíasʼse nonikid, weyob ega sognonikid:
“Israel-dulemar-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová soged: Rey-Sedequías anse-ibmar-idakega-dulemar-barmialidga be sogo: ‘Faraón-sordamar bemar-bendakega-ainis-danikoedi gannar biremaloed, gannar Egiptoʼse namaloed.
Babilonia-sordamar gannar wese we-neggweburgi-gwichiguega nonimaloed, bela bemar-gamaloed, degine, neggweburmar ogumakmaloed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová soged: “Melle be yeer itomalo, mer be binsamalo Babilonia-sordamar bar danikosurmarye. Suli, gannar Babilonia-sordamar danimaloed.
Ar bemar amba bela Babilonia-sordamar-ogalakusale, degi, unnila gwenna-gwenna nailikgus-besmalale, sunna wemar we-neggweburgi gwichigusmalaled, we-neggwebur ogumaksamalaled.”
Babilonia-sordamar, Faraón-sordamar-egi-daniye wisguarsoggu, Jerusalénʼgi bangudgusmalad.
Aisaar Jeremías, Jerusalénʼgi-gudiidgi nainu-ega-uklenaid-suega Benjamín-yarse aligusanad.

Degi-inigwele, Yawagak-Benjamínʼye-nugadse-mosgua, sordamar-e-dummad Iríasʼye-nugad Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Jeremías-gasad. Iríasʼde Selemías-machid, Hananías-wagwabalid. Geb Irías, Jeremíasʼga weyob sogded: —¡Babilonia-sordamarba akaye be soge!
Jeremías abin-sogded: —¡Wedi gakana. Babilonia-sordamarba an akasokarsulid! Degi-inigwele, Irías, Jeremías-ega-ibmar-soged itossulid. Aka gasa dummaganse sesad.
Dummagandi bela Jeremíasʼgi sae-itodmalad. Geb sarsosmalad-sorba garda-narmaked-Jonatán-negyaba osiapmalad. Ar ade, a-neg esgaryaga imaksamalad.
Deyobi, neg-urba-esgarya-siidgi Jeremías-metemalad. Agine dikasuli mellesii gusad.

Rey-Sedequías, Jeremías ega-e-negse-sedamalaga igar-uksad. Agine, rey, Jeremíasʼse arbakee weyob ibmar egichisad: —¿Bab-Jehová bega sunmaksa? Jeremías abin-sogded: —Eye, Dummad, anga sunmaksa. Bede Babilonia-e-reyga-uklegoye anga sogsad.
Jeremías, Rey-Sedequíasʼse egisdemogad: —Dummad, ¿ibigi an begi dummad-nossunna? ¿Ibugi an be-dummagangi, we-neggweburgi an dummad-nossunna? Emide be esgaryagi an-metegu.
¿Bia bega Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogmaladde nade? Bega sogsamalad: Babilonia-sordamar anmargi gwichiguosurye, degi, bemargi, we-dulemar gwichiguosurye bega sogsamalad.
Emide, Dummad, an bega ise-wilesakwaa soged, wis an bega ibmar-soged be an-itoge. Melle be bar gannar garda-narmaked-Jonatán-negse be an-barmide, degiile, an agi burgwidoed.

Geb agine, Rey-Sedequías igar-uksad, nakulemalad-neg-imbagi Jeremías-simaloye. Degi, neggweburgi madu-nikad-berguedse, bane-bane madu-yomalad-igarye-nugadgi madu-uklebubukwad ega ukmaloye sogsabalid. Degisoggu, deyob, Jeremías nakulemalad-neg-imbagi mellesii gusad.
